Name: Vampire Bedroom - Furniture Set
Author: JackR0
Description:
[color=#a61c00][b]Vampire Bedroom by Jack Rivers[/b]

[/color]I learned how to make furniture! I've been wanting to do this for a while and finally got around to it, and I'm excited to make more sets in the future!

[color=#a61c00][b]---------------------------------------[/b][/color]

[b]Includes:

[/b][list]
[*]3 Tables (Ottoman, Nightstand, Vanity)
[*]2 Decor (Candelabra, Skull Planter)
[*]1 Bed
[*]1 Chair (Stool)
[*]1 Light
[*]1 Painting (Shelf)
[*]1 Rug
[/list]
[color=#a61c00]---------------------------------------[/color]

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI - and requirements[/b]
[/list] ﻿ Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and CP (Content Patcher) are downloaded and up to date!

[b]﻿2. Vampire Bedroom[/b]
﻿ Install this mod!

[b]﻿3. Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Vampire Bedroom and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)

[b][color=#980000]---------------------------------------[/color]
[/b]
[b]Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*]If you find any issues or have any ideas for additions to this, as always, let me know!
[*]I highly recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ if you're downloading furniture mods! It gives you easy access to furniture through its own catalogue.
[*] ﻿(You can search "Vampire" to find my furniture easily!)
[/list]
